steps: 1. Setup Tailwind Config: Extend theme with 'Plus Jakarta Sans' and custom colors.
2. Global CSS: Import fonts, set body background to slate-50.
3. Layout Shell: Create Sidebar + Header layout using the 'Glass' style for header.
4. Dashboard: Implement 'Control Room' grid with KPI cards.
5. Onboarding Wizard: Use 'Tetris' grid, focus on generous spacing (p-8).
6. Task Lists: Use Shadcn Table but add 'hover_lift' to rows for interactivity.
anti_patterns: DO NOT use default Shadcn 'slate' colors without tinting them (use our defined palette).
DO NOT make the dashboard dense like Excel. Use whitespace.
DO NOT use pure black (#000000). Use slate-900.
universal_rules: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (APCA/WCAG AA).
Mobile-first: Always verify grid-cols-1 on mobile before expanding.
